major_cooldowns.name: Ultimate Penitence
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use it as a major healing and defensive cooldown separate from Evangelism, timed for a heavy damage window; as Voidweaver open the cast with Mind Blast to deploy your Rift first, and spell-queue Void Shield just before the cast finishes so it does not interrupt the channel.

major_cooldowns.name: Evangelism
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use it to ramp Atonement fast: it casts a free Power Word: Radiance and makes your next two Power Word: Radiance casts instant, so time it separately from Ultimate Penitence.

rule.description: Keep Shadow Word: Pain up on your target
rule.action: Refresh Shadow Word: Pain before it drops under 20 seconds remaining.

rule.description: Hold Power Word: Radiance charges for Evangelism
rule.action: Spend Power Word: Radiance on mini-ramps as it comes up, but bank two charges ahead of your Evangelism ramp.

rule.description: Hold Power Word: Radiance charges for Ultimate Penitence
rule.action: Spend Power Word: Radiance on mini-ramps as it comes up, but bank two charges ahead of your Ultimate Penitence cast.

rule.description: Mind Blast into Ultimate Penitence into Void Shield
rule.action: As Voidweaver, deploy your Rift with Mind Blast, then cast Ultimate Penitence, then spell-queue Void Shield right before the cast finishes.

rule.description: Shadow Word: Death replaces Smite in execute
rule.action: Swap your Smite filler to Shadow Word: Death once the target is in execute range.
